verified_findings.finding: Recent-conversation cache mirrors text into local-chat without canonical thread ID; restoration renders text while _threadId remains null. New Chat does not clear the active cache pointer.

_ChatMessage lacks stable message/turn/attempt/generation IDs. Failure rows are appended; retry removes positional/equal-text rows and submits with a new key. Cloud, thread-load, dictation and picker completions lack shared identity fencing.

Current picker is a transparent Material and uncontained fixed-position column. Header top inset ownership and viewport anchoring are fragmented; count-only/mutable-list change detection cannot represent streamed content revisions.

Cloud chat is buffered, separate from Activity progress streaming. Deployed native capability dispatcher emits the registry/runtime-evidence/model-assumption prose directly. Prompt-only remediation cannot fix the SQL-generated answer.

Bedrock receives prior roles flattened into text inside one user Converse message. Preserve role-aware history across every adapter and test parity; this alone does not prove the cause of recorded greetings.

Canonical Memory retrieval is now wired into deployed chat, superseding the older source-absence finding. In the scoped 72h assistant sample, 6 results recorded degraded canonical Memory and none recorded available. Existing M5 retrieval logs in scoped last7d:115; zero used_for_decision, used_for_routing or outcome linkage. The current healthy M5 task-context RPC returned two older lessons and no specific mobile-shell lesson.

The live chat sample has 13 model runs over 72h (6 success,7 fail),40 attempt rows. Run-level provider latency/TTFT/end-to-end fields and provider request IDs/status are unpopulated. This is a small operational sample, not a controlled benchmark or proof of duplicate user requests.

Current Android workflow builds/tests but has no APK install/emulator journey. No tracked integration_test harness exists. PR Android build SHA and UX test SHA can differ. ARM64-only debug artifact and signer/installed-APK identity require explicit verification.

durable_lessons: Persist canonical conversation and logical turn identity with cached text; never display unidentified cached text as if it belongs to a new server thread.
A stable logical turn survives retry; attempts and diagnostic events are separate. Unrelated later success must not falsely mark an earlier failed action recovered.
Fence all asynchronous UI and transport work by scope, conversation, turn, attempt/generation and draft revision; reuse existing Activity fencing instead of assuming it covers chat.
Separate routing preference, response-depth preference and execution receipt. Freeze dispatched settings; apply later preference changes to subsequent turns.
Activity status streaming is not assistant-token streaming. Trace the complete provider-to-transport-to-Dart-render path before claiming streaming.
Correct natural customer wording at its actual source, including deterministic database functions, while retaining internal factual verification.
Use actual layout constraints and keyed content-revision anchors. Do not diagnose double IME padding from nested widgets without checking Flutter inset consumption.
Compile/tests/Vercel READY do not prove mobile quality. Bind the full no-reset journey to the exact installed/distributed APK hash and source.

proposed_implementation.approach: Preserve the retained app-level shell; introduce one typed session/turn controller, identity-preserving local/remote store, versioned attempt/stream contracts, viewport/presentation coordinator and stable composer/picker. Add actual Android runtime tests and measured latency spans; ship compatible backend first, then exact-source signed candidate, then staged runtime acceptance.
